questions.question: Choose the correct form: 'She enjoys ___ to music every evening.'
'I stopped to smoke' means the same thing as 'I stopped smoking'.
Complète et explique : 'I remember ___ (meet) him for the first time at a conference.' Gérondif ou infinitif ?
Choose the correct form: 'He refused ___ the documents.'
The sentence 'She suggested to go to the cinema' is grammatically correct.
Explique la différence de sens : 'I tried to open the window.' vs 'I tried opening the window.'
Which sentence is grammatically correct?
choices: I avoid to eat fast food.
They managed to finish the project on time.
He admitted to steal the money.

questions.question: After prepositions, we always use the gerund (V-ing) form.

exercisenotion.description: Certains verbes sont toujours suivis du gérondif : enjoy, avoid, suggest, mind, consider, keep, finish, deny, imagine, practise, miss, risk, admit, etc. Ex : I enjoy swimming. / She avoids eating sugar.
Certains verbes sont toujours suivis de l'infinitif : want, decide, hope, plan, promise, refuse, seem, agree, afford, manage, need, expect, etc. Ex : I want to leave. / She decided to study abroad.

exercisenotion.notion: Verbes suivis des deux formes (avec ou sans changement de sens)
exercisenotion.description: Certains verbes acceptent gérondif et infinitif sans changement de sens (like, love, hate, start, begin, continue). D'autres changent de sens : remember/forget/stop/try + V-ing (action passée ou habituelle) vs + to infinitive (action future ou intentionnelle).
